artworks.title: Telemachus Leading Theoclymenus before Penelope
artworks.description: Jordaens' Nationalmuseum drawing: Telemachus presents the fugitive seer Theoclymenus to Penelope — Odyssey XV–XVII as Flemish baroque narrative.

films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's Italian Odyssey miniseries keeps Homer's Melampodid seer in the cast of Telemachus' return — Theoclymenus among the suitors' doom.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Books XV–XX — Theoclymenus flees Argos, sails with Telemachus, and prophesies the suitors' bloody end in Odysseus' hall.

popCulture.title: Theoclymenus
popCulture.description: Melampodid seer who reads bird-omens for Telemachus and foresees the slaughter in Ithaca.
